tech.title: 旧建筑低成本能源监控改造
tech.title_en: Low-cost Energy Retrofit for Old Buildings
tech.description: LoRaWAN 免布线 + 开源网关，老楼宇也能直接装得上。
tech.description_en: Wire-free LoRaWAN plus open-source gateways — even old buildings can be retrofitted directly.

tech.title: 智能视频分析
tech.description: 让每一路摄像头都长出「AI 大脑」——本地推理、实时响应、隐私安全。
tech.description_en: Give every camera an AI brain — local inference, real-time response, privacy-safe.

tech.title: 室内外一体化定位
tech.description: 人员胸卡定位与 SOS，车辆与高价值资产长期追踪，统一接入平台。
tech.description_en: Badge-based personnel positioning with SOS, long-term tracking for vehicles and assets, unified platform access.

tech.title: 无线环境监测
tech.description: LoRaWAN 低功耗入网、4G 直连云端的无线环境监测硬件组合。
tech.description_en: A wireless sensing lineup — low-power LoRaWAN probes and 4G collectors that connect straight to the cloud.

tech.title: 对话式语音 AI
tech.description: 端侧拾音 + 本地 ASR/TTS，端到端 0.3–0.5 秒响应，无需云端即可多语言对话。
tech.description_en: On-device audio capture with local ASR/TTS — 0.3–0.5s end-to-end response, multilingual dialogue without the cloud.

tech.title: 智慧仓库管理
tech.description: 本地视觉识别操作员，语音操控出入库，零培训零改造对接现有系统。
tech.description_en: Local vision recognizes operators, voice controls inbound/outbound — zero training, zero retrofit.

scenarios.title: 智慧精细化养殖
scenarios.description: 提高养殖效率，降低疾病和人工成本，保障养殖稳产增收。
scenarios.description_en: Raise efficiency, cut disease and labor costs, keep production stable.

scenarios.title: 智慧农业环境感知
scenarios.description: 精准微气候数据结合土壤水肥感知，助力精准农业生产。
scenarios.description_en: Micro-climate data plus soil moisture and nutrient sensing for precision farming.

scenarios.title: 园区安全管理
scenarios.description: 方便部署的人员定位及危险报警方案，保障人员安全。
scenarios.description_en: Easy-to-deploy personnel positioning and hazard alerts that keep people safe.

scenarios.title: 应急救援指挥与安全保障
scenarios.description: 专为灾后无网、弱网环境设计的应急数据采集与设备管理方案。
scenarios.description_en: Data collection and device management built for post-disaster no-network environments.

scenarios.title: 楼宇用能管理

scenarios.title: CodeCraft

scenarios.description_en: An AI-powered hardware coding platform — build your own smart hardware with zero experience.

scenarios.title: 零售语音采集与分析
scenarios.description: 边缘 AI 无侵入式门店服务质检：高清音频采集、智能对话分析、隐私安全保障。
scenarios.description_en: Non-intrusive in-store service QA with edge AI — HD audio capture, conversation analysis, privacy protected.
